reply_text: Sofia, it was **Pellow** (Pellow Home Living, the retail account), not Pellucid. Your February 17 exchange with Kwame in #coastal-team settles it: the lamp delivery at door 6 is on your retail account, and the container pickup is the Pellucid Harbor Logistics terminal work. The "PHL" acronym covers both companies, which is why you two got tangled.
